DESCRIPTION: Percentage of ordered quantity that was actually shipped.
Average number of days from order placement to actual delivery.
Count of orders that are at risk due to late delivery or quantity shortfall.
METRIC_SQL: COUNT_IF(s.DELIVERY_DATE > o.PROMISED_DELIVERY_DATE OR s.QUANTITY_SHIPPED < o.QUANTITY_ORDERED OR (o.ORDER_STATUS = 'OPEN' AND CURRENT_DATE() > o.PROMISED_DELIVERY_DATE))

DESCRIPTION: Percentage of delivered orders where the delivery arrived on or before the ERP promised date AND the full quantity was shipped.
METRIC_SQL: COUNT_IF(s.DELIVERY_DATE <= o.PROMISED_DELIVERY_DATE AND s.QUANTITY_SHIPPED >= o.QUANTITY_ORDERED) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) * 100

DESCRIPTION: Percentage of delivered orders where the delivery arrived on or before the carrier ETA AND the full quantity was shipped.
METRIC_SQL: COUNT_IF(s.DELIVERY_DATE <= s.CARRIER_ETA AND s.QUANTITY_SHIPPED >= o.QUANTITY_ORDERED) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) * 100

DESCRIPTION: Percentage of shipped orders where the shipment departed on or before the supplier commitment date AND the full quantity was shipped.
METRIC_SQL: COUNT_IF(s.SHIP_DATE <= o.SUPPLIER_COMMITMENT_DATE AND s.QUANTITY_SHIPPED >= o.QUANTITY_ORDERED) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) * 100

DESCRIPTION: Total dollar value of orders that are at risk due to late delivery or quantity shortfall.
METRIC_SQL: SUM(CASE WHEN s.DELIVERY_DATE > o.PROMISED_DELIVERY_DATE OR s.QUANTITY_SHIPPED < o.QUANTITY_ORDERED OR (o.ORDER_STATUS = 'OPEN' AND CURRENT_DATE() > o.PROMISED_DELIVERY_DATE) THEN o.QUANTITY_ORDERED * o.UNIT_PRICE ELSE 0 END)
SOURCE_COLUMNS: DELIVERY_DATE, PROMISED_DELIVERY_DATE, QUANTITY_SHIPPED, QUANTITY_ORDERED, UNIT_PRICE, ORDER_STATUS
